# Storytelling @ Stage 13 — Systematic Green

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Expression on this line

Storytelling capacity at Order 12 is multi-paradigm performance coordination: holding oral,
theatrical, cinematic, digital, and indigenous performance traditions in productive tension
without collapsing to one. The defining capacity is that the performance thinker can hold
multiple delivery paradigms simultaneously without needing to declare a single winner.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** comfort holding multiple performance paradigms as each partially valid.
- **UR:** the capacity to reason productively within multiple delivery frameworks.
- **LL:** a performance culture that values pluralism — multiple delivery traditions
  coexisting and informing each other.
- **LR:** the institutional structures that support performance pluralism.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** performance relativism — holding so many paradigms that no coherent
  performance emerges.
- **Dark allergy:** performance lock — remaining committed to a single delivery tradition as
  the only legitimate lens.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have constructed a performance metatheory (Stage 14) while
  actually just holding paradigms in pluralistic tension.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to evaluate which performance paradigms are more adequate.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Multi-paradigm performance reasoning:** the thinker reasons productively within multiple
  delivery frameworks.
- **Cross-media performance fluency:** the individual demonstrates competence across oral,
  theatrical, and digital delivery forms.
- **Non-adjudicating comparison:** performance paradigms are compared without declaring a
  single winner.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:** Fischer-Lichte, *The Transformative Power of Performance* (performance as
multi-paradigmatic); Bauman, *Verbal Art as Performance* (performance as pluralistic practice).
**Open joints:** How does performance pluralism shade into performance metatheory (Stage 14)?
**Research debt:** pairs with `12-formal-landmark` (formal performance modeling) and
`14-metasystematic-teal` (performance metatheory).
